proposedProtocol.framing: One length-prefixed UTF-8 JSON request and response; EOF required; reject duplicate keys, nonfinite values, trailing bytes and unknown fields
proposedProtocol.hostDerives: Owner, CAS intent/expected digest, semantic origin validity, input digests, provenance, mappings and verification applicability come from trusted compiler/inventory; plugin cannot grant these.
proposedProtocol.identityChecks: Host-owned execution/stream binds exact immutable request, profile and launched process. Responses cannot select authority. Recompute all digests.
proposedProtocol.unknownOrUnsupported: BLOCKED before launch for unknown capabilities/profile; invalid result FAIL without publication
